description:
pickyourmatch finds travellers the exact bookable accommodation — not a room category. Every unit is individually described down to the view, the floor, the beds and the per-unit child and dog allowance, with data refreshed nightly from each property's GauVendi system.

Ask for "an apartment in Schladming for 2 adults, 2 kids and a dog, 16–19 August" and the app returns units that are actually available for those dates, with the real nightly rate and a direct booking link that opens the property's own booking calendar with the exact unit and dates preselected — no portals, no middleman, no fees on top.

Also included: themed promotions and packages (dog holidays, romance, wellness, culinary) with included extras, searchable by city or theme. The app is read-only, needs no account and processes no personal data.

defaultPrompt: Plan a long weekend in the mountains with our dog — somewhere cozy with great food
Find me a room with a panoramic view on a high floor — and show me exactly which room I'd get
